```{r setup, include = FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
#| label: load-data
#| message: false


### Read in data here
actions_data <- read.csv("../data/green-actions-workflows.csv")
```

```{r}
#| label: calculate statistics
#| message: false

mean_duration <- mean(actions_data$duration)
duration_quant <- as.numeric(quantile(actions_data$duration))
branches <- unique(actions_data$branch)

branch_first <- actions_data |>
    filter(branch==branches[1])
branch_second <- actions_data |>
    filter(branch==branches[2])
branch_third <- actions_data |>
    filter(branch==branches[3])
p_firstblock <- "warning"
p_secondblock <- "danger"
p_thirdblock <- "primary"

```

## Row {height="50%"}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Total time"
list(
  icon = "clock",
  color = p_firstblock,
  value = duration_quant[3]
)

```


```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Time for branch X"
list(
  icon = "clock",
  color = p_secondblock,
  value = duration_quant[4]
)

```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Time for branch Y"
list(
  icon = "clock",
  color = p_thirdblock,
  value = duration_quant[1]
)
```

## Row {height="80%"}

```{r}
# Put in the bubbleplot

workflow_start_time <- as.POSIXct(actions_data$workflow_start_time, format = "%H:%M:%S")

p <- ggplot2::ggplot(actions_data) + ggplot2::geom_point(aes(x = start_time, y = workflow_name, size = duration, color = branch)) + xlab("Workflow start time") + ylab("Workflow name") + ggtitle("Run duration: workflow name against timestamp for different branches")+theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

p
```
